PARCEL Fund — fractional real-estate token marketplace
One accent family: mint #2EE6A8 with cyan #22D3EE as its only companion, on near-black with a faint teal cast. No purple, pink, red or secondary green anywhere — negative P&L reads in muted neutral rather than red. Glass panels (translucent, blurred, hairline rim) over an ambient teal wash. Space Grotesk display, IBM Plex Mono on every number.

Everything is clickable: filter tabs, quick-buy presets, the token slider, tab switching, watchlists, claim rent. The accent chip above each artboard shifts the whole system within the teal family.

All prices, yields, addresses and sponsor names are sample data for feeling out the flow — swap them before this goes anywhere real. The Reg D / 12-month lockup line on the buy panel is a placeholder too: your counsel decides the actual offering language.
